combatText.title: Weavefield Protection
combatText.general: Gain 1 (S) for each of your unrouted units. *newline* Spend 1 (S) to gain 1 [S].

combatText.title: Medipack Supplies
combatText.general: Gain 1 [S]. *newpara* During this execution round, the health value of your units is increased by 1.
combatText.unit: Hearthkyn/Bastion Vessel: Spend 1 [S] to rally 1 of your units and gain 1 (S).

combatText.title: Call For Backup
combatText.general: Spend 1 [S] to place 1 free reinforcement token in this area.

combatText.title: Suppressive Fire
combatText.unit: Hearthkyn/Hearthguard/Bastion Vessel: If you have more [B] than your opponent, convert 1 of your dice into [B].

combatText.title: Scan For Enemies
combatText.general: Either gain 2 (B) or gain 2 (B) at the start of the next execution round.
combatText.unit: Hearthkyn/Bastion Vessel: Your opponent discards the top card of his combat deck. Gain 1 of the icons on that card as dice.

combatText.title: The Hearth Burns
combatText.unit: Hearthkyn/Hearthguard/Bastion Vessel: Gain either 1 (B) or 1 (S) for each [M] you have more than your opponent.

combatText.title: Scanned Shot
combatText.general: Discard a card from your hand to gain 2 (B).
combatText.unit: Hearthguard/Bastion Vessel: During the assess damage step of this execution round, your opponent assigns 1 additional damage.

combatText.title: It's Kin
combatText.general: Either convert 1 of your [S] into [M] or convert 1 of your [M] into [S].
combatText.unit: Bastion/Hearthkyn/Pioneer/Bastion Vessel: Spend 1 [B] to convert 1 of your [B] into [M]. *newline* Gain 1 [M].

combatText.title: Pragmatic Withdrawal
combatText.unit: Hearthkyn/Hearthguard/Bastion Vessel: Spend either 1 [B] or 1 [M] to gain 3 (B).

combatText.title: Iron Concussion
combatText.general: Gain 1 [B], 1 [S], or 1 [M]. *newpara* Force your opponent to choose and discard a combat card from his hand.
combatText.unit: Hearthguard/Bastion Vessel: Force your opponent to lose 1 [M] and 1 (S).

combatText.title: Armour of the Forge
combatText.general: Gain 1 [S]. *newpara* Spend up to 2 [S]. For each [S] you spend, gain 1 (S).

combatText.title: Teleport Crest
combatText.general: Gain 1 [B] and 1 (B). *newpara* Reroll 1 of your dice.
combatText.unit: Pioneer/Stronghold: Gain 2 (S). *newline* Return 1 of your faceup combat cards to your hand to play 1 combat card from your hand. Do not resolve its abilities, but gain its combat icons until the end of this combat.

combatText.title: Hearths of Fire
combatText.general: Gain either 3 (B) or 3 (S) unless your opponent spends 1 [M].
combatText.unit: Pioneer/Stronghold: Gain 2 (B) and 2 (S) unless your opponent spends 1 [M].

combatText.title: Void in our Veins
combatText.general: Rally 1 of your units. *newline* Convert 1 of your [M] into either [B] or [S].
combatText.unit: Stronghold: Take 1 of your routed or unrouted ships from this area and place it on a friendly area. Take 1 unrouted Bastion Commerce Vessel from any area and place it on this area.

combatText.title: Ancestors are Watching
combatText.unit: Fortress/Stronghold: Move 1 of your units to this area from this or any adjacent system to gain either 3 (B) or 3 (S). *newpara* At the start of the resolution phase you may move any of your units from this area to any number of friendly or uncontrolled areas in this or adjacent systems.

combatText.title: Eye of the Ancestors
combatText.unit: Fortress/Stronghold: Your opponent loses 3 dice of your choice.

combatText.title: Return to Ancestors
combatText.general: Either convert up to 2 of your [S] into [B] or convert up to 2 of your [M] into [B].
combatText.unit: Fortress/Stronghold: During this combat, when any of your units are destroyed, gain materiel equal to that unit's materiel cost reduced by 1.

ordersText.title: A.N – VYL Workstation
ordersText.general: While resolving your faction ability, if you purchased a combat card with a maximum command level of 2, you may spend 1 forge token to take a second combat card of either the same or lower command level you purchased and place it in your combat deck. Then remove a combat card from your combat deck and place it in your combat upgrade deck. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Ironkin Wayfinder
ordersText.general: After you resolve this order, you may spend 1 forge token to both place 1 of your order tokens from your play area onto the top of your event deck, and you may move 1 of your ships in the active system to any friendly or uncontrolled void in either the active system or an adjacent system. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Traders of the Void
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, if you have an unrouted ship in the active system gain 1 forge token. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Hold Worlds
ordersText.general: When you purchase a bastion while resolving this order, you may spend 1 forge token to place that bastion on a friendly world that already contains exactly 1 bastion. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Celestial Hammerfall
ordersText.general: During this orbital strike, gain 1 extra [D] for each of your participating ships and ignore dice limit restrictions. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: Waste Feeds the Void
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. During this orbital strike, you may spend 2 [S] to choose and destroy 1 structure on this world. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: Prosperous Traders
eventsText.general: Gain 2 different assets of your choice.

eventsText.title: Planetary Mining
eventsText.general: Choose a system that contains any of your ships and choose a world in that system. Gain materiel equal to its materiel value.

eventsText.title: Sailing to Far-Space
eventsText.general: Purchase 1 order upgrade, ignoring its command level restrictions and reducing its materiel cost by 1 for each friendly void containing your ships.

eventsText.title: Toil Earns
eventsText.general: Gain 2 forge tokens and gain 1 materiel for each forge token that would exceed your maximum asset limit.

eventsText.title: Oathband
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the start of an execution round of combat, you may discard this card to take 1 of your units with a maximum command level of 2 from any world and place it on this world.

eventsText.title: Ancestor Core
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the start of an execution round of combat, you may discard this card to discard a combat card from your hand. Resolve both abilities on that combat card even if you do not have the listed units in the combat.

eventsText.title: Targeted Effort
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* While resolving an orbital strike, you may discard this card to choose and rout 1 enemy unit on that world before assessing damage.

eventsText.title: Ironkin Support
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the start of a reinforce step of combat, you may discard this card and spend 1 forge token to place 2 free reinforcement tokens in this area.

abilities.title: Hearth of the Forge
abilities.text: When you resolve a dominate order, you may either purchase an order upgrade, reducing its materiel cost by 1, or purchase a combat upgrade at half the materiel listed on the card. Place only 1 copy of the purchased combat card into your deck. Then remove 1 combat card from your combat deck and place it into your combat upgrade deck. The paired card may only be purchased with this ability and not by a Strategize Order.
